cand.title: 31 Congreso Nacional de Cardiología 2027 + III Congreso de Cardiooncología SIAC
cand.excerpt: Medical delegate lodging and ancillary needs are credible, but current venue is committed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Dr. Carmen Encarnación, 2027 organizing committee chair, is the most relevant named logistics/operations contact. Dr. Vizmary Pineda Frías, SODOCARDIO president 2025–2027, is the executive relationship and referral contact. Their roles are verified; authority to sign hotel contracts is not. Approach both through the association office rather than inventing personal contact details.
findings.futureEdition: Verified activity dates: 17–20 June 2027, within the requested horizon. The 15 June 2026 Diario Salud article explicitly announces these 2027 dates; they are not publication dates. WorldTelevision independently lists the same dates. No later edition date is verified.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel brief and Wyndham’s published specifications: the all-inclusive Uvero Alto resort is plausible for a guestroom-led delegate/sponsor subgroup, an optional extended stay or a separately scoped small meeting. It is a poor like-for-like replacement for this main congress: the announced programme uses five concurrent academic rooms, while Wyndham publishes three venues totaling 380 m² and capacity up to 300 conference guests. More than 300 regional specialists are expected for the joint cardio-oncology component alone. This is a meeting-layout constraint, not a demonstrated room shortage.
findings.venueCommitments: Announced venue: Centro de Convenciones del Hard Rock Hotel Punta Cana / Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Punta Cana. This is a named event commitment, not generic resort promotion. The planned RCP training for Hard Rock staff further ties the programme to that property. A signed contract, guestroom allocation and exclusivity terms were not published in reviewed sources.
findings.historicalRotation: 2019: 15–18 May, International Convention Center Punta Cana–Hotel Hard Rock; 2021: 3–6 June, Punta Cana Convention Center, with hotel identity not explicitly established by the reviewed history page; 2023: 22–25 June, Hard Rock convention center; 2025: 19–22 June, Hard Rock convention center. 2027 returns to Hard Rock. Evidence shows Punta Cana continuity and a strong Hard Rock incumbent, not proven destination rotation or an annual cycle.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 lodging sourcing is unknown; no verified public room-block quantity, housing tender, booking deadline or overflow request was found. Start with SODOCARDIO. Its 2025 official page identifies Turinter as official tour operator and the 2025 congress site identifies Turinter as organizing agency, but neither establishes a 2027 appointment. WorldTelevision lists 2027 audiovisual production and staging, not housing procurement. Do not equate any of these roles with contract control.
findings.organizationStructure: Association-led scientific congress, not a corporate incentive programme despite the seed segment. SODOCARDIO is the announcing organizer; SIAC supplies the jointly held cardio-oncology congress. Hard Rock is the host venue, Turinter is a verified historical tour operator/organizing agency for 2025, and WorldTelevision self-lists a 2027 audiovisual/staging service role. The 2027 housing buyer or PCO is not established.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Hard Rock is the announced 2027 host and a documented repeat host. The five-room simultaneous academic programme creates an additional main-event fit limitation for Alltra. No sourced sell-out, rejected room request, overflow block or transfer arrangement was found. No demand is attributed to Cap Cana, La Romana or Bayahibe.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact the SODOCARDIO office at sodocardiord@gmail.com / (809) 685-0331, requesting an introduction to Carmen Encarnación and Vizmary Pineda. Ask who controls 2027 housing, whether Hard Rock arrangements permit off-site accommodation, whether any unmet sponsor/delegate subgroup need exists, and whether Turinter is reappointed. Do not quote an overflow block before these answers. If a discrete requirement is confirmed, offer a guestroom-led proposal with meeting capacity and transfer requirements explicitly stated; otherwise retain a relationship-development record, not an active open-venue opportunity.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 is upcoming, but the principal venue opportunity is already committed to another hotel. Lodging accessibility remains unconfirmed, not open and not proven fully closed. Treat possible off-site delegate/sponsor rooms or ancillary activity as a hypothesis requiring organizer consent and actual demand evidence.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: build an association relationship for future smaller programmes or explicitly authorized guestroom subgroups, rather than assuming capture of the full congress. The 2019/2021/2023/2025/2027 sequence supports an observed two-year cadence, not a confirmed next edition. No post-2027 event date, venue tender or opening within May 2028 was verified. Full-congress capture remains weak given incumbent continuity and Alltra’s meeting footprint.
